title: Royal Indian Navy Mutiny
summary: Indian ratings of the Royal Indian Navy began a hunger strike at the shore establishment HMIS Talwar in Bombay on 18 February 1946, angered by their commanding officer's insults and by conditions. The strike spread to ships and other bases, including Calcutta and Karachi, and ended in surrender on 23 February 1946 after nationalist leaders urged them to give up.

uncertainty.note: Start 18 February 1946 (hunger strike at Talwar); surrender 23 February 1946 per Indian History Collective.

as_recorded.value: a hunger strike commenced on 18 February

importance.justification: Large naval strike in the last years of British rule in India that spread across several ports and shaped nationalist politics.
